purpose: m= and scale= on C and L cards were dropped (C1 1u m=2 ran as 1u); R, C and L with m=2 in series and parallel, and scale=, against closed forms.

oracle.derivation: A 1 V step into first- and second-order RC, RL and RLC branches, the instance factors as ngspice applies them: C_eff = m*scale*C (captemp.c:94, capload.c:74-79), L_eff = scale*L/m (indtemp.c:79, indload.c:111-113), R_eff = scale*R/m. o1: tau = 1k*2u, 1 - e^-1 at 2 ms. o2: R_total = 1k + 500, C = 2u, tau = 3 ms, v = 1 - (2/3) e^-1 at 3 ms. o3: Thevenin 0.5 V behind 500 ohm into 2u, 0.5 (1 - e^-1) at 1 ms. o4: C = 2u + 1u, 1 - e^-1 at 3 ms. o5: series R = 1k, L = 50m, C = 2u, overdamped: s1,2 = -a +- sqrt(a^2 - w0^2), a = R/(2L), w0^2 = 1/(LC), i(t) = (e^(s1 t) - e^(s2 t)) / (L (s1 - s2)), v(o5) = 1 - R i(1 ms). o7: L = 10m behind 10 ohm, e^-0.5 at 0.5 ms. o8: R = 1k, C = 0.5u*2*2 = 2u, 1 - e^-1 at 2 ms. o9: L = 10m*2/4 = 5m behind 10 ohm, e^-1 at 0.5 ms. Cross-check: ngspice-45 (ngspice -b) reads every value within 1e-5 relative. rtol 2e-4 covers the 1 ns edge, the 10 us step and find-at interpolation (under 6e-5 on the 0.5 ms time constant), and stays under the 0.1% perturbation.
